time_basis: rollout seconds at 30Hz control; provisional boundaries, not verified takeoff times
basis: User-observed open-stance to closed-stance jumps; reference root height and hip-roll changes in seed42 telemetry
limitations: Hip roll is a pose proxy, not foot separation; forward kinematics has not been computed.
planned_flight_close is intended flight, not a declaration of actual takeoff.
Contact measurements aggregate all ankle-link normal collisions, including possible self contacts.
These labels are not loaded by training, evaluation control or deployment.
